svg.text: Scaling strategy for frontend, backend, storage, search and deployment. Three traffic paths are traced, because each one scales differently.
BROWSE — read-heavy, cacheable, must never block
BOOK — write, strongly consistent, lowest volume
PUBLISH — async fan-out, rebuilds search and caches

Browse path: CDN or edge SSR → listing service → Redis → Postgres read replica. A listing render never touches booking or payments.
Book path: gateway → booking service → Postgres primary, then an event. Search is never written to directly — indexers rebuild it from the stream.
This submission implements the Web SPA box only: a static React bundle on a CDN, with content as a typed module standing in for the shape the listing service would return.
Media here is served as static files under /images, which matches the object-storage plus image-CDN path above, without the transcoding pipeline.
